item.title: Germany's far-right AfD wins Saxony-Anhalt state election, seeks to form government
item.description: Germany's far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) won a historic victory in Sunday's state election in Saxony-Anhalt, taking 43.8% of the vote and falling three seats short of an outright majority, and is now seeking support from other parties to form a government.
